Name: Panini's cute baby
Author: Panini0zy
Description:
In this mod, I focused on changing the appearance and size of the vanilla babies of Stardew to a more adorable appearance.
There is a default texture in the [CP] folder of the mod, as well as another folder with resources so that you can choose your baby's features and customize them completely

To be honest, I based it on an image of some very similar sprites (if not identical) that I saw a couple of years ago. I completely don't know who the original author of the images is, but feel free to mention it if you find it :D

To make the image of your babies you will need an image editor or to do Photoshop (actually you just have to overlay the images from the 'resources' folder, I already did the hard work for you ;) ), and then replace the default baby image in the [CP] folder of this mod KEEPING THE ORIGINAL NAME AND EXACTLY THE SAME, OTHERWISE, THE MOD WILL NO LONGER WORK.

Someone was kind enough to give me the link to the original author's post about the mod; apparently, it's this one. Give it lots of love: https://stardewsally.tumblr.com/post/156246150142/working-on-this-little-mod-that-makes-your-baby

Downloads.Description: This is the [CP] mod in full, it contains the default baby sprite. You can replace the image with your custom baby, or play with this one.
